s: Our five words today are all about nature.
The sky is the big space above us.
The sun is in the sky.
In the morning, the sky is bright.
At night, the sky is dark.
And at night we see the moon.
The moon is round and bright.
The moon is in the sky at night.
The moon gives us light at night.
I look at the moon from my window.
Do you like the moon, Maya?
When the moon is big, I smile.
And next to the moon, we see a star.
A star is a small bright light in the night sky.
I see one star, then I see another star.
A star is small but bright.
So many stars in the sky!
One star, two stars, three stars.

Now, our fourth word is leaf.
A leaf is the flat green part of a tree.
I see a leaf on the tree.
A leaf is small and flat.
In spring, the leaf is new and green.
I pick up a leaf from the ground.
Do you like a leaf, Lena?
And our fifth word is stone.
A stone is a small hard rock.
A stone is gray and smooth.
We find a stone on the road.
I have a stone in my hand.
We make a small tower with a stone and another stone.
